description: This file defines a test class 'TrieBasedPolicyAlgorithmTest' for testing the 'TrieBasedPolicyAlgorithm' in the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract test class and overrides a method to instantiate the specific policy algorithm implementation.

classes.name: TrieBasedPolicyAlgorithmTest
